topic: Perplexity tricks research pros keep quiet
angle: Two Perplexity features change how fast you can research anything.
hook: Nobody talks about the Perplexity trick that turns 3 hours of research into 15 minutes
caption:
Perplexity has a free feature called Focus that most users never touch. Turn it on and your searches ignore junk sites and only pull from Reddit, academic papers, or YouTube. Pair it with Follow-up questions and you get a working research assistant in your pocket. What is the last thing you researched that took way too long?

#ProfitPrompts #AITools #ClaudeAI #ChatGPT #AIWorkflow #Productivity #AIhacks #TechTips

slides.text: Nobody talks about the Perplexity trick that turns 3 hours of research into 15 minutes
You need the free Perplexity account. Focus mode is one click away.

slides.title: Turn on Focus mode
slides.body: Under the search bar, tap Focus. Pick Reddit, Academic, or YouTube depending on what you need. This alone cuts noise by 80%.

slides.caption: what a full research session takes when Focus and Follow-up work together

slides.title: Ask follow-up questions in the same thread
slides.body: After the first answer, ask 'What are the counterarguments?' or 'What did they get wrong?' Perplexity remembers context and drills deeper each time.

slides.text: Consultants at big firms use this workflow daily and charge $300/hour for the output. The tool is free.
Save this. Try Focus + Follow-up on your next research task and screenshot the time you save.
